items.text: Its legislators voted unanimously to suspend a law raising the retirement age, freezing that age until 2028.
Its legislators voted against the annual social insurance budget that carried that suspension and dropped a planned freeze on pensions and minimum benefits.

Its alternative budget proposed no change to the public health insurance that covers everyone who works or lives legally in the country. The only health measure reported in it was replacing medical aid for undocumented migrants with emergency-only care.
Published an alternative budget proposing to end non-contributory benefits for foreigners who have not worked full-time for at least five years.
In the same alternative budget, proposed lifting a freeze on social benefits and returning the retirement age to 60 or 62.
